sources.usage: Project brief, enums, allowed design space, ranges, and schemas.
Public/cleared/provisional source usability registry; distinguishes formal-ready, background-only, provisional-only, and needs-review materials.
Agent-readable navigation layer for scopes, required tasks, source-use boundaries, and missing-data checklist; not a new authority source.
Three required detailed-design key area boundaries (provisional).
Official announcement tasks, scope levels, key areas, language, and deliverable context.
Agent-facing open-call principles, six required agent tasks, scenario/branding/operation requirements, and boundary clause.
Known official area values and missing statutory control indicators (FAR/height/density/green ratio/setback).
National land-use classification guide; conceptual land-use codes used for partition labeling only.
OpenStreetMap license notice; OSM used only as conceptual basemap and display reference, ODbL attribution retained.

sources.note: Mechanism references: (1) Singapore Punggol Digital District / JTC, https://www.jtc.gov.sg; (2) Shenzhen Intelligent Connected Vehicle regulation & low-speed unmanned vehicle pilots, official municipal releases 2022-2023; (3) Japan Aichi smart mobility test field (爱知县实证试验场); (4) Hangzhou Yunqi Town annual developer conference; (5) Seoul Digital Media City, https://dmc.seoul.go.kr; (6) Munich IABG urban traffic test site, https://www.iabg.de; (7) Tokyo Kashiwa-no-ha smart city, https://www.kashiwanoha-smartcity.com; (8) Barcelona 22@, https://www.22barcelona.com. URLs and dates are recorded best-effort for narrative background; each mechanism is transferred conceptually, not copied in form.
